articles.headline: Tech stocks tumble as investors question AI spending and China competition
articles.summary: Technology shares fell sharply as investors reassessed the scale of AI infrastructure spending and the competitive threat from Chinese memory-chip makers. The move matters for businesses because it signals possible pressure on cloud, chip, and AI infrastructure costs, while also affecting supplier valuations and investment plans across the tech stack.

articles.headline: Asia chip markets slump on AI sell-off and China chipmaking gains
articles.summary: Asian markets sold off heavily, with major chip names in South Korea and Japan falling as investors worried about AI spending, semiconductor valuations, and advances in Chinese chipmaking equipment. For executives, the key implication is potential volatility in memory and semiconductor supply chains, along with tighter scrutiny of AI capex assumptions.

articles.headline: Swift launches blockchain shared ledger with 16 banks
articles.summary: Swift has launched a blockchain-based shared ledger with 16 banks including Citi and HSBC to support round-the-clock payments. For businesses, this could eventually reduce settlement friction, improve cross-border payment speed, and reshape competition with stablecoins and other payment rails.
